Xveave Technologies - Xveave is pronounced "X-Weave". The name is weave with an X factor.

Your business is the differentiator. AI is the amplifier.

Helping organizations amplify what makes their business unique through AI-powered
enterprise products, SAP innovation, and bespoke solutions. Bespoke solutions,
AI-embedded platforms, and industry innovations on SAP and modern AI.

## Products

- DesignVeave (pronounced "Design Weave") - an AI-assisted platform for SAP
  S/4HANA implementations, from fit-to-standard workshop preparation to build.
  It holds requirements, solutions and decisions as one connected model,
  identifies the gaps, and turns approved gaps into functional and technical
  specifications, a build plan and a configuration cookbook.
  https://xveave.com/designveave/

- AssortVeave (pronounced "Assort Weave") - an AI-assisted assortment
  intelligence engine for brands that sell through stores they don't own:
  distributors, wholesale customers and retail partners. It helps you decide
  which products each store should carry, explains why, and shows the effect
  of a change before you commit to it. Early access.
  https://xveave.com/assortveave/

## Insights

- Why SAP design decisions go unrecorded, and what it costs later
  SAP projects record what was configured, rarely why. What a review of four design documents showed, what the gap costs, and how to close it.
  https://xveave.com/insights/why-sap-design-decisions-go-unrecorded/

- What to send business users before a fit-to-standard workshop
  A fit-to-standard workshop works when business users arrive having seen the process. What to send them a week ahead, and what to leave out.
  https://xveave.com/insights/fit-to-standard-workshop-preparation/

- How to get an AI coding agent to write SAP code that fits the design
  A coding agent given a prompt guesses. Given a build plan drawn from the approved design, it builds what was agreed. What that plan must contain.
  https://xveave.com/insights/ai-coding-agents-sap-build-plan/

- How brands get the right product into stores they don’t own
  A retailer plans its own shelves. A brand selling through partners controls only which products each customer can order. How to make that decision well.
  https://xveave.com/insights/assortment-intelligence-for-brands/
